selection_rule: Literature-informed global defaults fixed without holdout access; no per-family or per-scale tuning.

UCB1_EDGE.citation: Auer, Cesa-Bianchi, and Fischer (2002), Finite-time Analysis of the Multiarmed Bandit Problem

A_STAR.citation: Hart, Nilsson, and Raphael (1968), A Formal Basis for the Heuristic Determination of Minimum Cost Paths

Q_LEARNING.implementation_note: Tabular off-policy Q-learning; epsilon decays linearly by protocol episode while learning continues during evaluation.

UCB1_EDGE.implementation_note: Project operationalization: outgoing edges are arms and receive bounded Monte-Carlo episode reward. This adapts UCB1 to delayed path credit; it is not claimed as a canonical graph UCB procedure.

RANDOM_RESTART_GREEDY.implementation_note: Project operationalization: each protocol episode is a position restart; randomized exploration and persistent path penalties vary greedy restarts. No free within-episode teleport is allowed.

MEMORYLESS_GREEDY.implementation_note: Deterministic argmin of local delta times base resistance; lexicographic tie-break; no learning state.

EPSILON_GREEDY.implementation_note: Fixed-epsilon local exploration without learned values.

UNIFORM_RANDOM.implementation_note: Uniform choice among currently outgoing edges.

A_STAR.implementation_note: Full static topology, no hidden outcome probabilities. Zero heuristic is admissible for all heterogeneous state IDs and makes optimality cross-checkable against BFS.

D_STAR_LITE.implementation_note: D* Lite incremental replanning over full static topology, with observed failed edges changed to infinite cost for the current episode. Hidden outcome schedules are not exposed.

audit.legacy_benchmark_sota: Not reused: single-episode Q-learning and inconsistent FAILURE movement do not satisfy E0-G1-v1.
audit.legacy_benchmark_gridworld_astar: Algorithmic idea retained, but replaced by a protocol adapter with explicit map-information labeling and FAILURE replanning.
audit.bfs: Not a preregistered method. Retained only as a unit-cost oracle to verify A* and D* Lite path optimality.
audit.upper_reference_exclusion: A_STAR and D_STAR_LITE are excluded from the G1-B comparator because they receive full topology.
